ethnicity.legal_basis: Fair Housing Act §3604, 42 USC §3601 et seq.
ethnicity.notes: Race, color, national origin forbidden as a basis of decision; HUD disparate-impact rule applies.

gender.legal_basis: FHA §3604; HUD final rule 2021 on sex incl. orientation/identity

marital_status.legal_basis: FHA familial status §3604; many state laws add marital status

criminal_record.legal_basis: HUD 2016 Guidance on use of criminal records in tenant screening
criminal_record.notes: Blanket bans on applicants with any conviction create disparate-impact liability.
